cdc_yellow_book_2026.label: CDC Yellow Book 2026 — High-Altitude Travel and Altitude Illness
cdc_yellow_book_2026.scope: General high-altitude acclimatisation, illness-recognition and descent principles. Not Enkiama operating-partner evidence.

imec_responsible_travel.label: IMEC / Kilimanjaro Responsible Trekking — Partner for Responsible Travel
imec_responsible_travel.scope: Benchmark framework for verifiable crew-welfare systems. Enkiama does not claim partner status unless independently confirmed.

public_principles.label: Time matters
public_principles.statement: Rate of ascent and sleeping altitude materially affect altitude-illness risk; a longer itinerary creates more opportunity to acclimatise but cannot guarantee an individual response.

public_principles.label: Symptoms change the plan
public_principles.statement: A climber with symptoms of altitude illness should not continue ascending to a higher sleeping altitude.

public_principles.label: Descent is a safety decision
public_principles.statement: If symptoms worsen despite rest or treatment at the same elevation, descent is the priority.

medical_boundary: Enkiama route comparison does not assess medical fitness, diagnose altitude illness or replace advice from a clinician familiar with high-altitude travel.

operator_protocol.source_required: Documented confirmation from the actual Kilimanjaro operating partner and any applicable park/authority requirements.
